revision_summary: Three quote timestamp errors need correction on rerun: the '$1.70 to... $1.80 range' quote is timestamped 02:22 in three places (multi_touch_patterns[0].touches[1], cherry_pick_moments[3], and coaching_focus[0] — the priority-1 coaching item) but actually occurs at 03:22-03:23 in the transcript; at 02:22 the customer is mid-weather-small-talk ('degree high for a day... Yeah. Winter.'). Fix all three timestamps to 03:22. Additionally, before asserting this figure as escalating utility-bill pain (used as the foundation for the top coaching priority and repeated in the handoff brief as 'Dominion, $1.70-$1.80 range and climbing'), Stage 3 should flag the ambiguity: the surrounding dialogue is about trucking-related fuel/diesel costs ('they're doing all this fuel stuff', 'lowest fuel costs', per-diem/mileage/rental car talk), so $1.70-$1.80 more plausibly refers to fuel price per gallon than an electric bill dollar figure. This doesn't necessarily kill the bill-pain coaching angle (the $1,000/month figure at 01:23 is unambiguous and still supports it) but Stage 3 should not conflate the two numbers as one escalating utility bill without flagging the uncertainty, per the numeric_discipline schema rule against unverified quantitative claims. Separately, reclassify cherry_pick_moments[1] (the 'That's not right' pushback on credit/title terms) away from 'knowledge_gap' — the rep isn't facing a question he can't answer, the customer is disputing stated program terms that also drifted from schema in an undocumented way (the rep's 'we don't go by the end of the month anymore' claim isn't in the schema at all) — this is a schema_drift_detection instance that should be flagged for Kenny reconciliation, similar to the existing SESSION18_fcbf33c1 650-vs-670 drift note. No fabrications rise to critical severity and the outcome dispute is well-supported, so this is a targeted revision, not a full rerun.
